[RBND.8.1] Every consumer of the **dialect-binding** comparison
([RBND.6.1]) MUST carry at least four conformance tests:

  - identical tuples → `DS_OK`
  - mismatched `dsc_sha256` → `DS_ERR_BND_DSC_MISMATCH`
  - mismatched `capabilities` (single-element delta) →
    `DS_ERR_BND_DIALECT_MISMATCH`
  - tuples naming different dialects whose settings resolve alike →
    `DS_OK`

A consumer may drive the third and fourth tests at its comparator rather than
through a container. `dsc_sha256` hashes the whole DSC, header included
([RDSC.3.6]), so no two compiled artefacts differ in `capabilities` alone, and
the comparison stops at the second test's code first. The third test presents a
tuple whose `capabilities` differ by one element under an equal `dsc_sha256`.
The fourth presents the tuples of two DSCs compiled under different dialect
names whose settings resolve alike: the tuple carries no name ([RBND.1.3]), so
they compare equal.
